scripts.deploy:
: "${TAYORI_D1_DATABASE_ID:?Set TAYORI_D1_DATABASE_ID to the remote D1 database ID}" && : "${ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN:?Set ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN}" && : "${ACCESS_AUD:?Set ACCESS_AUD}" && : "${ALLOWED_EMAIL:?Set ALLOWED_EMAIL}" && secrets_file=$(mktemp) && trap 'rm -f "$secrets_file"' EXIT && printf 'ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN=%s
ACCESS_AUD=%s
ALLOWED_EMAIL=%s
' "$ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN" "$ACCESS_AUD" "$ALLOWED_EMAIL" > "$secrets_file" && npm run build && cf deploy --prebuilt --secrets-file "$secrets_file"
scripts.typecheck: cf workers types && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.client.json
scripts.db:migrate:remote: cf d1 migrations apply "${TAYORI_D1_DATABASE_ID:?Set TAYORI_D1_DATABASE_ID to the D1 database ID}" --dir ../../migrations
scripts.db:migrate:preview: cf d1 migrations apply "${TAYORI_PREVIEW_D1_DATABASE_ID:?Set TAYORI_PREVIEW_D1_DATABASE_ID to the preview D1 database ID}" --dir ../../migrations --mode preview
